mineral_and_site: Lead (lead-zinc) froth; industrial; Jin Dong lead-zinc flotation plant, China

data.n_images: Classification study: 6 images (Table 1) + 30 images (10 large-bubble, 20 middle/small/tiny) for corner-count rule; segmentation figures/quantitative count comparison on 4 images (large, middle, small, mixed-size); paper states method 'tested for a large number of lead froth images' without a number
data.colour: grey-level processing (images described as colour mineral froth; method operates on grey values)
data.annotation_type: manual bubble delineation for 4 images (built by manually completing a rough Watershed result); bubble counts
data.annotator_and_object_count: annotator not stated; manual counts 231 / 451 / 1537 / 500 bubbles (large / middle / small / mixed-size images)

method: (1) Improved Harris corner detection (corner if smaller eigenvalue > threshold; one strong corner kept within a tolerance distance) counts white spots; rule: threshold 5, tolerance 11 px, >200 corners = non-large-bubble image, otherwise large-bubble image. (2) Edge detection by improved local grey-value minima: directional (0/45/90/135 deg) minima tests using weighted neighbourhood averages (w1=w3=0.2, w2=0.6) in a 5x5 kernel for large-bubble images, 3x3 for non-large; second 5x5 test for plateau minima in 8 directions. Binary edge image.
held_out_test: no - classification rule derived and illustrated on the same small image sets; no separate test split for segmentation
instance_level_metrics: yes, only bubble count per image vs manual delineation (no matching, no IoU/AP)

method: (1) Improved FCM clustering extracts highlight (light-spot) regions; binarization + morphology gives spot edges. mineral_and_site: Tungsten-molybdenum flotation; industrial plant in Jiangxi, China

method: Marker-controlled watershed with fused markers and edge constraints. Markers: three parallel highlight extractors - IFCM (2 clusters), adaptive local-mean threshold (25x25 window, C=5), open-close morphological reconstruction (disk radius 3, global threshold 200) - regions split into small/medium/large by area and fused per size class (small: IFCM ∩ (ATM ∪ MROC); medium: area-filtered IFCM ∩ (ATM ∪ MROC), threshold 50-70% of mean medium area; large: union) = 'highlight overlap correction'. Edge constraint: LoG (0/90 deg) ∪ ±45 deg gradient kernels, erosion-dilation with 3x3 square, minus markers dilated by 6 px to remove highlight pseudo-edges.
held_out_test: no - hand-set parameters, no train/test split; evaluated on 50 annotated images
instance_level_metrics: partially - ARI over pixel labels compares region partitions (penalises splits/merges) but no per-bubble matching, AP or size-distribution error
